notes: §15.3.1: "Every function type has a hidden bit `s ∈ {sync, susp}`. A sync function may be used wherever a suspending one is expected." §15.3.3: "**Function types inside data** (record fields, …) are **suspending by default**. Storing a sync function there is allowed … Write `@sync fn(…) -> R` in the field type to require and preserve a sync function." Positive twin: a sync function stored in a (suspending by default) field.
